::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's first 'CIDM' (collaborative IDM) project — pooling IC-design firms, end-application companies, and the manufacturer as joint investors — founded by Richard Chang (Zhang Rujing), who also founded SMIC.
:::

**Chinese name:** 芯恩（青岛）集成电路 (Xīn'ēn (Qīngdǎo) Jíchéng Diànlù)

## What does this facility make?

Logic/foundry, analog/power, and RF/wireless chips at 28nm and 40nm on both 200mm and 300mm wafers.

## Why does it matter?

A structurally different ownership model (collaborative IDM, not a pure foundry or a single-owner state fab) from every other entry in this tracker, and notable for its founder's direct SMIC lineage.
